06/07.05.2025 I.A. No. 5404 of 2025 Heard Mr. Sheo Kumar Singh, the learned counsel for the appellant and Mr. Pankaj Kumar, the learned P.P. for the State.
This application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail during the pendency of this appeal.

The appellant has been convicted for the offences under section 376-AB of the Indian Penal Code and section 6 read with section 5(1) and (q) of the POCSO Act and has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for twenty years along with a fine of Rs.5000/- for the offence punishable under section 6 read with section 5(1) and (q) of the POCSO Act.
It has been alleged that on the pretext of marriage the appellant had established physical relationship with the victim as a result of which she had become pregnant.
It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the appellant that the age of the victim has been assessed to be 15-16 years.
It has further been submitted that there was a love affair between the appellant and the victim.

The learned P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the appellant and has submitted that the victim has given birth to a child and the DNA report reveals that the appellant is the biological father of the child which was born to the victim.
Regard being had to the above, we are not inclined to grant bail to the appellant and the same is hereby rejected.
